Name: Mpac 7 Peck CSK Issues
Description: Machine was getting stuck during peck at CSK, added cycle break for DF pos 0
Author: mgriffis

ContentBlocks.TextContent: <FlowDocument FontSize="14" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" Background="#FF1A1A1A" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" ColumnWidth="Auto" IsOptimalParagraphEnabled="False" PageWidth="Auto" PageHeight="Auto" PagePadding="5,0,5,0" IsHyphenationEnabled="False" AllowDrop="True" NumberSubstitution.CultureSource="User" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">Mpac 7 was getting stuck sending DF to pos 0 during Peck at CSK. Germany added a condition to Cycle Break the machine when DF has reached the Home position. This breaks the machine cycle loop it was getting stuck in. This only treated the symptoms and not the actual cause.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
ContentBlocks.PlainTextContent: Mpac 7 was getting stuck sending DF to pos 0 during Peck at CSK. Germany added a condition to Cycle Break the machine when DF has reached the Home position. This breaks the machine cycle loop it was getting stuck in. This only treated the symptoms and not the actual cause.
